title: ALMA Lensing Cluster Survey: Dust mass measurements as a function of redshift, stellar mass, and star formation rate from z = 1 to z = 5
question: How do average dust mass of galaxies evolve with redshift (z=1 to 5), stellar mass and SFR, measured by stacking ALCS band-6 continuum at HST-IRAC catalogue positions?

data.sensitivity: average map RMS ~63 uJy/beam (per-cluster values in Table 1)

what.value: HST-IRAC catalogue: positions, redshifts, SFRs, stellar masses, magnifications

evidence.quote: We extracted the positions, redshifts, physical characteristics (SFRs and stellar masses) as well as lensing magnifications of galaxies at $1\leq z \leq 5$ from the HST-IRAC catalog presented in (cite: Kokorev2022).

what.value: Dust opacity kappa = 0.0431 m^2/kg at nu0 = 352.6 GHz

evidence.quote: We used $\kappa_{\nu_0}$=0.0431 m$^2$ kg$^{-1}$ with ${\nu_0}=352.6$ GHz (cite: Li2001; Magnelli2020).
We used $\beta=1.8$, the Galactic dust emissivity index measurement from the *Planck* data (cite: Planck2011)

what.value: Main sequence SFR_MS for Delta(MS) (quiescence diagnostic)

evidence.quote: the expected SFR for a galaxy with the same stellar mass and on the MS (cite: Speagle2014)

what.value: COSMOS2020 stellar mass function used for sample completeness check

evidence.quote: we compare its stellar mass function (SMF) to the one derived in the COSMOS2020 sample (cite: Weaver2022; Weaver2023)
This is corrected by following Equation 18 of (cite: DaCunha2013).
following (cite: Sun2022) and (cite: Fujimoto2023) we use a magnification uncertainty of 20% of the magnification associated to each subsample

recipe.goal: Select the source sample from the HST-IRAC catalogue
recipe.method: Sequential cuts on redshift, quality, mass, SFR, H-band magnitude, primary beam level, z range and magnification, leaving 4103 sources
assumptions: Spectroscopic redshifts used where available, otherwise photometric; SFR and stellar mass corrected for magnification

recipe.goal: Bin sources into redshift, stellar mass and SFR subsamples
recipe.method: Four redshift bins split by either four stellar-mass bins or five SFR bins
key_parameters: Redshift bins 1-2, 2-3, 3-4, 4-5; individually detected sources not excluded

recipe.goal: Stack 1.2 mm continuum and measure stacked flux
recipe.method: Unweighted mean stack, pixel to pixel, single channel mode, on uv-tapered images; flux integrated in a central circle of radius 2 arcsec and divided by beam area in pixels
key_parameters: Stamp size 9.76 x 9.76 arcsec^2 (61 x 61 pixels)

recipe.goal: Estimate stack noise and set detections / upper limits
recipe.method: Empty stacks from random source-free coordinates with the same stamp size and number of targets, 1000 realisations per subsample; standard deviation gives RMS; flux below 3 RMS replaced by a 3 sigma upper limit

recipe.goal: Correct stacked flux for lensing magnification
recipe.method: Divide the stacked flux by the average magnification of the subsample; alternative of correcting each stamp before stacking gives consistent fluxes
assumptions: Noise is independent of magnification so per-stamp correction would reduce stacking efficiency

recipe.goal: Convert 1.2 mm flux to dust mass
recipe.method: Single optically thin modified blackbody with CMB correction, using the Kovacs2010/Magnelli2020 equation
key_parameters: beta = 1.8; kappa = 0.0431 m^2 kg^-1 at nu0 = 352.6 GHz
CMB flux correction ~1.03 at z~1 to ~1.31 at z~6; CMB dust-temperature heating ~3% at z=6
assumptions: Mass-weighted dust temperature T_rest = 25 K at all redshifts

recipe.method: Bootstrap each subsample 1000 times, take 16th to 84th percentile and sum quadratically with stack RMS; propagate redshift percentile spread and a 20% magnification uncertainty
assumptions: Adding bootstrap and RMS errors quadratically is an approximation that slightly over-estimates the error (they are correlated)

recipe.goal: Fit scaling relations of dust mass with M*, SFR and z
recipe.method: Quadratic fits to detections only, ignoring upper limits, when at least 3 points are available
Repeat stacking after removing sources with Delta(MS) < -0.5

evidence.quote: In total, our full sample finally adds up to a total of 4103 sources.

answer_key.quantity: Lowest stack standard deviation (z=1-2, lowest M* and SFR bins)

evidence.quote: reaches levels as low as $\sim4.3 \times 10^{-3}$ mJy per beam

answer_key.quantity: Stacked flux range for detections (before magnification correction)

evidence.quote: $\sim1.78 \times 10^{-2}$ mJy and $\sim1.04$ mJy for stack detections

answer_key.quantity: Range of securely extracted dust masses (S/N > 3, after magnification correction)
Fit M_dust(z) at fixed SFR 10<SFR<50: coefficient a
Fit M_dust(z) at fixed SFR 10<SFR<50: coefficient b
Fit M_dust(z) at fixed M* 10^9<M*<10^10: coefficient b

evidence.quote: In total, 2157 galaxies are removed from the sample, leading to a final size of 1946 after removing quiescent galaxies.
